'''PushDMM4''' is a medium-sized [[Deathmatch Mode 4|dmm4]] map created by [[Image:flag_au.gif]] [[Povo-Hat]] in [[2007]].

==Gameplay==
Players are shot into the air upon spawning by trigger_push wind tunnels. Intended for [[Rocket Launcher|RL]] only play, the map soon proves to have a nice size for ground battles and be tall enough for midairs.
